headline: Microsoft issues emergency fix for compromised eMudhra certificates
summary: Microsoft released out-of-band Windows updates to remove trust in certificates tied to compromised eMudhra certificate authority keys, protecting systems that don't receive automatic certificate trust list updates.

claims.statement: Microsoft released out-of-band Windows updates related to eMudhra certificates.
